provisional_features.gap_summary: Validated observation (explicit_owner_boundary): N-002 clearly delegates runtime-state and runtime-identity semantics to their owner documents and forbids assistant-local re-ownership.
cross_domain_terms: assistant runtime ownership boundary is explicit

provisional_features.title: Live events and mobile commands lack deterministic failure envelopes
provisional_features.summary: The event names, chat lookup keys, and mobile command defaults are explicit, but event ordering/idempotency and normalized command outcomes are not.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Validated observation (event_ordering_and_mobile_command_outcomes): The event names, chat lookup keys, and mobile command defaults are explicit, but event ordering/idempotency and normalized command outcomes are not.
cross_domain_terms: live events and mobile commands lack deterministic failure envelopes

provisional_features.title: User-question escalation is explicitly parent-mediated
provisional_features.summary: Children do not get a direct user channel; clarification is routed through the parent question flow, preserving parent ownership of user interaction.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Explicit non-gap (none): Children do not get a direct user channel; clarification is routed through the parent question flow, preserving parent ownership of user interaction.

provisional_features.title: Interview max-question transition is both resolved and unresolved
provisional_features.summary: The resolved soft-cap rule force-completes after max+1 and never rejects valid answers, but the later wiring instruction still leaves over-max behavior as 'either reject or accept depending on product rule.'
provisional_features.gap_summary: Validated observation (contradictory_state_transition): The resolved soft-cap rule force-completes after max+1 and never rejects valid answers, but the later wiring instruction still leaves over-max behavior as 'either reject or accept depending on product rule.'
cross_domain_terms: interview max-question transition is both resolved and unresolved

provisional_features.title: Interview min/max domain validation is absent
provisional_features.summary: The numeric contract defines defaults, optional unlimited max, and max+1 arithmetic but not min<=max, zero handling, per-phase override precedence, integer bounds/overflow, migration from the old field, or validation errors shown to users.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Validated observation (input_domain_unspecified): The numeric contract defines defaults, optional unlimited max, and max+1 arithmetic but not min<=max, zero handling, per-phase override precedence, integer bounds/overflow, migration from the old field, or validation errors shown to users.
cross_domain_terms: interview min/max domain validation is absent

provisional_features.title: Force-completion can bypass required architecture confirmation
provisional_features.summary: The max-question rule force-completes a phase without an exception for confirmation gates, while require_architecture_confirmation says the flow must wait for explicit confirmation before allowing phase completion; precedence and recovery are not defined.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Validated observation (gate_bypass_contradiction): The max-question rule force-completes a phase without an exception for confirmation gates, while require_architecture_confirmation says the flow must wait for explicit confirmation before allowing phase completion; precedence and recovery are not defined.
cross_domain_terms: force-completion can bypass required architecture confirmation

provisional_features.title: Coordination Concurrency And Scale
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "coordination-concurrency-and-scale" normalizes 2 validated observations: Coordination overflow is specified as both admission control and destructive pruning; Conflict detection fails open when coordination state cannot be read.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Coordination overflow is specified as both admission control and destructive pruning [contradictory_active_agent_limit_and_overflow_transition]; Conflict detection fails open when coordination state cannot be read [fail_open_conflict_projection_read]

provisional_features.title: Coordination Locking And Recovery
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "coordination-locking-and-recovery" normalizes 1 validated observations: Canonical locking and recovery behavior remains owner-unresolved.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Canonical locking and recovery behavior remains owner-unresolved [unresolved_live_locking_and_recovery_policy]

provisional_features.title: Coordination Registration And Cleanup
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "coordination-registration-and-cleanup" normalizes 2 validated observations: Projection, gating, and destructive GUI policy remain behaviorally ambiguous; Subagent execution lifecycle can leak coordination state and trust parsed output.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Projection, gating, and destructive GUI policy remain behaviorally ambiguous [missing_projection_gate_and_destructive_action_oracles]; Subagent execution lifecycle can leak coordination state and trust parsed output [missing_execution_cleanup_and_untrusted_output_normalization]

provisional_features.title: Crew Admission And Scheduling
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "crew-admission-and-scheduling" normalizes 8 validated observations: Crew mode has explicit parent, attribution, and memory rules; Gap-era crew examples are terminally noncanonical; Crew admission caps are singular and fail closed; Future Assistant crew UX inherits canonical limits; Crew scheduling lacks fairness and tie-breaking rules; Crew-aware plan hints lack accepted schema semantics; Crew recommendation JSON is not live schema; Interview crew behavior is a separate orchestration lane.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Crew scheduling lacks fairness and tie-breaking rules [queue_priority_and_fairness_gap]; Crew-aware plan hints lack accepted schema semantics [crew_hint_schema_and_consumer_gap] | explicit non-gaps: Gap-era crew examples are terminally noncanonical; Crew recommendation JSON is not live schema | validated non-gap observations: Crew mode has explicit parent, attribution, and memory rules; Crew admission caps are singular and fail closed; Future Assistant crew UX inherits canonical limits; Interview crew behavior is a separate orchestration lane

provisional_features.title: Crew Message Board
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "crew-message-board" normalizes 2 validated observations: Crew message target precedence is undefined; Crew message lifecycle lacks transition rules.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Crew message target precedence is undefined [multi_target_routing_ambiguity]; Crew message lifecycle lacks transition rules [message_state_machine_unspecified]

provisional_features.title: Durable Crew Board Routing And Lifecycle
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "durable_crew_board_routing_and_lifecycle" normalizes 4 validated observations: Abnormal execution cleanup and output parsing are incomplete; Inherited-domain conflicts and durable-message governance remain open; Projection and durable message records have distinct responsibilities; Crew routing and lifecycle need security and distributed-state rules.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Abnormal execution cleanup and output parsing are incomplete [underspecified_execution_failure_and_detection_bounds]; Inherited-domain conflicts and durable-message governance remain open [conflict_resolution_and_durable_message_governance_missing]; Crew routing and lifecycle need security and distributed-state rules [routing_authorization_distributed_throttle_and_state_machine_missing] | validated non-gap observations: Projection and durable message records have distinct responsibilities

provisional_features.title: Structured Handoff
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "structured-handoff" normalizes 5 validated observations: Mandatory handoff degrades to partial success; Handoff schema identity and limits are open; Malformed findings are silently discarded; Provider output format is registry-driven; Retryable validation uses terminal error state.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Mandatory handoff degrades to partial success [contract_self_weakening]; Malformed findings are silently discarded [silent_validation_loss]; Retryable validation uses terminal error state [retry_state_semantics_inverted] | unknowns: Handoff schema identity and limits are open [schema_resource_limits_unspecified] | validated non-gap observations: Provider output format is registry-driven

provisional_features.title: Structured Handoff Validation
provisional_features.summary: Local feature family "structured-handoff-validation" normalizes 2 validated observations: Expiry guard and platform handoff enforcement; Validation observability and cache gaps.
provisional_features.gap_summary: gaps: Validation observability and cache gaps [raw_output_privacy_and_cache_invalidation] | validated non-gap observations: Expiry guard and platform handoff enforcement

provisional_features.title: Coordination Event, Read-Model, and Debug-Mirror Storage
provisional_features.summary: Partitions active-agent coordination into canonical events, checkpoint-gated projections, and post-commit non-authoritative mirrors.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Coordination recovery and scale-edge behavior are open; Event payload validity is not buildable from this registry; Per-event invariants and transition legality are unspecified; Projection checkpoint admission is stated but not operationalized; Cross-projection atomicity and partial rebuild behavior are missing; Mirror publication failure handling is underspecified; Privacy prohibition is explicit but not locally testable; Inspection-view truth states are not specified; Retention, scale, and destructive maintenance remain non-executable; Coordination storage behavior lacks executable falsification; Essential semantics remain dependent on unresolved owner seams

relationships.rationale: The interview submit flow consumes and specializes the shared question lifecycle but retains interview-specific authority and failure handling.
Parent-mediated escalation depends on the shared question lifecycle without becoming that lifecycle.
Context shaping transforms selected history while chat-history mutation retains separate persistence and restoration authority.
The broad message-command lifecycle uses the bounded composer queue but also owns cancel, steer, edit, resend, timeout, and restore behavior.
Message-command handling invokes send and stop concurrency rules while retaining broader queue-command authority.
Edit and resend commands affect history, but the command lifecycle and durable history lifecycle remain distinct.
Crew-message targeting and lifecycle overlap durable board routing, but the latter also carries distributed security, conflict, and cleanup authority.
Structured-handoff validation evaluates handoff artifacts but has separate expiry, observability, privacy, and cache behavior.
Crew admission and scheduling consume concurrency caps while retaining scheduling fairness and crew-specific policy.
Locking and recovery act on canonical coordination state while storage owns event, projection, and mirror persistence.
Registration and cleanup update coordination state but do not own its storage lifecycle.
Crew coordination consumes message-board behavior while preserving broader crew authority and projection semantics.
Prompt admission consumes isolated draft state, but inbox admission and draft persistence have different lifecycles.
Dashboard and HITL handoffs consume attention actions while retaining separate correlated-thread and execution authority.
The interview max-question transition can alter submit-flow admissibility and terminal behavior.
Force-completion semantics conflict with confirmation gates and the unresolved over-max transition.
The broad F-021 through F-027 verification concern includes the annotation surface but also spans several distinct integration seams.
Browser context can become a visible draft attachment, while sharing and revocation retain recipient-scoped authority.
